rendered: Of the cathodes named, LFP has the highest practical capacity in the review: it delivers a practical capacity of 170 mAh g^− 1[1], through the Fe2+/Fe3+ redox couple. The review gives LCO a theoretical capacity of 274 mAh g^− 1[2], but only about ≈140 mAh g^− 1[3] is typically available for practical applications. So LCO's practical capacity is roughly half its theoretical value, and well below LFP's practical figure. LNO is given only a theoretical capacity in the review (about 275[4] mAh g-1), with no practical capacity stated, so it cannot be ranked on practical capacity.[5][6]
